notes.title: Steam Leaderboards 1.1
notes.content:
Hi everyone, sorry for the gap in updates, been busy for us with some of us going back to college and others graduating. 
This update includes a new header for the leaderboards and actually shows player names as well! On the programming side I'm looking into better compatibility with Vive and Index, and a new enemy!

notes.title: Steam Leaderboards Integration 1.0
notes.content:
This update features a new integration with Steam Leaderboards! Now in the waiting area, look up to see your high score and compare it to others in the leaderboards above! 
This currently doesn't show the user associated with each score, but this is a feature that is soon to come!
[b]The leaderboards are now also visible in the Community Hub![/b]
Let us know your feedback in the comments.

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
Implemented level streaming with Unreal Engine to help level loading be less jarring. Includes a very basic loading screen! I plan to add some sort of saving for your score as the next feature!

Check it out with the new update and let me know what you think!
